decisions.decision: Assignments: Paula to investigate the lake Shirley, 860 Reservoir, 0 Lake Shirley and 725 Goodrich Street parcels; Mike to investigate 225 Pleasant Street; Brandon to reach out to Dave Prokoview on West Street; Bob to GPS the West Street trails.
